summary: A long running med spa with clear starting prices is a strength, but an expired offer, old blog posts and enquiry sections with no forms appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The hero says 'Your path to billiant skin', and the brand appears as NCBC Med Laser, NCBC Med-Laser and NCBC Med-Laser Ltd.
findings.cost: A typo in the main headline weakens a premium brand.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one brand name.

findings.problem: MAKE AN INQUIRY and Request your free consultation below have no form, the mailing list shows no sign up field, and both Book buttons go to the contact page.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book or ask a question face dead ends.
findings.fix: A working consultation form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: A Spring offer that ended April 30, 2026 still shows, the newest blog post is from 2022, and a June Spotlight from 2019 still advertises 30% off.
findings.cost: Expired offers and old posts make the clinic look inactive.
findings.fix: Offers and news you can update in minutes.

findings.problem: The gallery repeats the same after images, Instagram posts use placeholder.png, and two phone numbers and a second Lawrence Avenue location appear only in the footer.
findings.cost: Repeated images and hidden details weaken proof and confuse patients.
findings.fix: A real results gallery and clear location pages.

redesign: A working consultation form with WhatsApp.
Offers and news you can update in minutes.
A real results gallery and clear location pages.
